verdict.line: You lose if you let Gwen chip you down with Snip Snip! and vanish into Hallowed Mist every time you close distance; you win if you land Death's Grasp before her Skip 'n Slash is up and force a stand-and-fight.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's whole plan is to remove Gwen's kiting with Death's Grasp and win the ensuing brawl with Indestructible sustain and Obliterate's single-target bonus; Gwen's whole plan is to poke with Snip Snip! from just outside your E range and disappear behind Hallowed Mist the moment you commit. The matchup is decided by who dictates the engage — Mordekaiser wins games he starts, Gwen wins games she starts.

theirWindow.when: Both her Q and W are up
theirWindow.what: She can poke with Snip Snip! and then hide in Hallowed Mist the instant you step in, since only enemies who enter the mist can target her — don't chase, back off and reset the wave instead.

yourWindow.when: Your E is up, her E is down
yourWindow.what: Walk her Skip 'n Slash on cooldown and immediately Death's Grasp; without the dash she can't escape your Obliterate-into-auto combo before Darkness Rise triggers.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The extra AP and two charges of sustain offset Snip Snip!'s true-damage poke while you wait for E to come off its 16s rank-1 cooldown.

boots.why: Gwen's entire kit — Q, E on-hit, R, and her passive execute — is magic damage; the flat MR cuts every source of her poke and burst.

core.why: The slow keeps Gwen inside your Obliterate range after you Death's Grasp her, denying the reposition she'd get from Skip 'n Slash.
Omnivamp turns your W (Indestructible) shield-and-heal loop into sustained lane dominance through her poke.
Burn damage punishes her for standing in Hallowed Mist trying to out-heal your combo with her passive.

situational.when: you're already ahead and want to make your Indestructible heal and Riftmaker omnivamp effectively unbeatable in extended fights
she's building on-hit and her Skip 'n Slash attack-speed window is doing more damage than her spells
the game goes long and you need more raw magic pen against her mixed magic resist build

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking healing from autos and spell hits lets you out-sustain Snip Snip! poke and win the extended trades your E-Q combo creates.

summoners.why: This is the dominant pick in the matchup (76.9% of games) because Mordekaiser holds the solo-kill advantage — Ignite turns any landed Death's Grasp into a real kill threat rather than just a poke exchange.

playing.title: Hold E for her dash cooldown
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in the area on a cooldown that drops from 16s to 8s at max rank; throw it the moment Skip 'n Slash is down so she can't dash out of your follow-up.

playing.title: Respect the 450 range on Q
playing.detail: Snip Snip! only reaches 450 and deals true damage to whatever's centered in the cone; step outside that range between trades so she isn't landing free snips for nothing.

playing.title: Don't chase into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: Only champions who enter the mist can target Gwen while it's up; walking in just to get poked is a losing trade, so back off and let the 22s-to-18s cooldown run instead.

playing.title: Bank Indestructible for the all-in
playing.detail: Store damage with W through the poke phase and consume it right after your E-Q lands, not before, so the heal covers both what you deal and what you take in the actual fight.

playing.title: Realm of Death right after her E
playing.detail: She only gets a partial cooldown refund on Skip 'n Slash if it hits, so pulling her into Realm of Death immediately after she's used it traps her without a fresh dash for the 1v1.

playing.title: Front-load damage, don't extend
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts heals Gwen off bonus magic damage the longer a fight runs; land Obliterate for its single-target bonus early rather than trading autos back and forth.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, boots, and summoner picks are pulled directly from measured Mordekaiser vs. Gwen games (498 sampled) on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read, not sourced data.
